Privacy Policy

How information is handled when you visit this website or contact Compass Media.

Information you provide

When you send a project inquiry, you may provide your name, company, email address, service interest and message. Compass Media uses this information to respond to your request and discuss relevant services.

Website and form providers

This website is hosted through GitHub Pages. Project inquiries are processed by FormSubmit and delivered to Compass Media by email. These providers may process technical information required to deliver the website and your message.

How information is used

Information you send may be used to respond to your inquiry, prepare requested services and maintain appropriate business records. Compass Media does not sell the personal information submitted through this website.

Your choices

You may choose not to provide optional information. To ask about information you previously submitted, contact Compass Media directly.

Contact

Questions about privacy can be sent to sandra@compassmedia.io or discussed by calling 512-900-4053.
